title: Git dependency pinned through a semver fragment
description: package.json declares a git dependency whose fragment asks npm to resolve a semver range instead of committing to one tree. The install resolves the range against the remote's tags at fetch time, so the compiled tree can move without a manifest change and without a lockfile review.
remediation: Pin the fragment to a full commit sha and record the resolved commit in review.
limitation: It matches a git dependency whose fragment asks npm to resolve a semver range instead of committing to one tree in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
